rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something easily damaged or needing careful handling.

example.english: These glass cups are delicate, so be careful when carrying them.
example.traditional: 呢啲玻璃杯好脆弱，拎嗰陣要小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 bo1 lei4 bui1 hou2 ceoi3 joek6 ling1 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person whose health or physical strength is weak.

example.english: He has a delicate constitution and needs to rest after walking a few steps.
example.traditional: 佢身體虛弱，行幾步就要抖吓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 san1 tai2 heoi1 joek6 haang4 gei2 bou6 zau6 jiu3 tau2 haa5

rows.note: Use this for a gentle washing setting or cycle intended for fragile clothes.

example.english: Use the delicate cycle to wash this shirt, or it may easily get damaged.
example.traditional: 洗呢件衫要用輕柔模式，唔係好易整爛。
example.jyutping: sai2 ni1 gin6 saam1 jiu3 jung6 hing1 jau4 mou4 sik1 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 zing2 laan6

rows.note: Use this for tactful, considerate behaviour that avoids offending or overstepping.

example.english: You need to be delicate when discussing other people's private matters; don't push your questions too far.
example.traditional: 講人哋私事要有分寸，唔好問得太盡。
example.jyutping: gong2 jan4 dei6 si1 si6 jiu3 jau5 fan1 cyun3 m4 hou2 man6 dak1 taai3 zeon6
